blockers.detail: generated file is absent from the model: references to and from it are not analysed, and it must be regenerated for the new package

notes: Shared-state detection is syntactic (unexported fields accessed across parts, package-level locks); sharing through parameters, interface fields or unexported types is not detected.
Package-level var/const uses are found by identifier match, not name resolution; a shadowing local is miscounted.
Every part is assumed to become a new package path; importers are attributed to the parts whose symbols they call, and importers with no attributable use are assumed to need every part.
1 generated files are absent from the model; references to or from them are not analysed.
